options.command: PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.88 rustc)"):$PATH" rustup run 1.88 cargo test --manifest-path packages/geospec-engine-native/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --target-dir node_modules/.cache/geospec-engine-native/target

PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.88 rustc)"):$PATH" rustup run 1.88 cargo check --manifest-path packages/geospec-engine-native/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --target-dir node_modules/.cache/geospec-engine-native/target
PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.88 rustc)"):$PATH" rustup run 1.88 cargo fmt --manifest-path packages/geospec-engine-native/rust/Cargo.toml -- --check

PATH="$(dirname "$(rustup which --toolchain 1.88 rustc)"):$PATH" rustup run 1.88 cargo clippy --manifest-path packages/geospec-engine-native/rust/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets --target-dir node_modules/.cache/geospec-engine-native/target -- -D warnings
